scripts.dev: node scripts/summary.js && concurrently -n "INFO,BE,FE,MCP,MAIL" -c "cyan,green,blue,yellow,magenta" "node scripts/summary.js --delay=10000" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w mcp-server" "npx maildev --smtp 1025 --web 1081"
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:sync && npm run prisma:generate -w backend && npm run prisma:generate -w mcp-server
scripts.db:init: cd apps/backend && rm -rf .wrangler && npx wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --local --command="SELECT 1" && npx wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --local --file=./src/database/schema.sql
scripts.db:deploy: cd apps/backend && npx wrangler d1 execute edustack_db --remote --file=./src/database/schema.sql
scripts.db:studio: npm run db:sync && cd apps/backend && npx prisma studio
